title.en: The Sun, the Moon and the stars

text.en: The colour of the sky changes in the morning, afternoon and night. The Sun's colour and the Moon's shape seem to change.

Have you looked up at the sky? It appears different at different times of the day.
The colour of the sky changes in the morning, afternoon and night, and so does the colour of the Sun.
Even the size and shape of the Moon seem to change over time.
Birds, animals, trees and humans also act differently during the day.
Draw the morning, afternoon and night sky and write what you observe: orange sky and orange Sun in the morning, strong sunlight in the afternoon and Moon and stars at night.
Share and compare observations with classmates.
